text: RB-101 [GKE Pod OOMKilled Exit 137]: Check recent deployment rollout diff in namespace, capture JVM/Go heap dump, rollback canary if memory leak confirmed, or increase container memory limit by 1.5x.
RB-102 [BigQuery Unpartitioned Scan Cost Spike]: Enforce maximum_bytes_billed query guardrail, partition fact tables by ingestion timestamp, and throttle svc-reporting slot reservation.
RB-103 [PostgreSQL / PgBouncer Connection Pool Exhaustion]: Inspect pg_stat_activity for idle-in-transaction locks, terminate blocking queries older than 60s, and scale PgBouncer max_client_conn.
RB-104 [Kafka Consumer Group Rebalance Storm & Lag]: Increase max.poll.interval.ms to 600000, stabilize pod HPA scale-down cooldown, and verify partition assignment stickiness.
RB-105 [Cloud NAT Port Exhaustion & External 502/504]: Increase minimum ports per VM on Cloud NAT router, enable dynamic port allocation, and verify HTTP keep-alive connection pooling.
RB-106 [Webhook Secret Leak & Prompt Injection Defense]: Revoke exposed API/HF bearer token immediately, scrub PII/secrets via regex redaction filter, and quarantine untrusted payload.
RB-107 [GKE Spot VM Preemption & Autoscaler Thrashing]: Apply PodDisruptionBudget minAvailable=2, migrate stateful workloads to on-demand node pool, and set node-pool anti-affinity.
RB-108 [Redis Cache Stampede / Thundering Herd]: Enable probabilistic early expiration (PER), add jitter to TTL values, and activate singleflight request coalescing.
RB-109 [Istio mTLS / gRPC TLS Certificate Expiration]: Trigger cert-manager emergency certificate rotation, restart istio-ingressgateway pods, and verify SPIFFE trust bundle.
RB-110 [Orphaned Persistent Disks & Idle GPU Node FinOps Cleanup]: Take final snapshot of unattached disks older than 14 days, scale idle GPU node pool to zero, and notify FinOps owner.
